# brig image list

List base images, newest first

## Synopsis

```text
brig image list
```

Also: `brig image ls`.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
